title: China Creek Campground and Marina

services.name: Campsite
services.desc: Port Alberni fishing is easier with direct access from China Creek Marina! Our full service marina offers convenient onsite amenities to accommodate our mariners. The marina has 82 slips and more than 1700 lineal feet of side tie moorage and we accommodate boat camping. The marina has a gas dock offering both marine fuel and diesel, a four lane launch ramp, fish cleaning station, electrical hook-ups and pump-out station. We also offer propane services, ice, salt ice, washrooms, showers and coin-operated laundry facilities. services.name: Loft Cabins
services.desc: Looking for a different kind of getaway? Come stay in our new rustic oceanfront cabins that include beds and mini fridges. Wake up to incredible views, and enjoy your own front porch oasis. Enjoy one of four Suite Cabins. Our Suite Cabins comfortably sleep up to six, featuring a queen bedroom, a loft with a queen bed (accessed by stairs in the kitchen), and a double pullout couch. The kitchen includes a fridge, cook element, toaster oven, and dual coffee maker. Enjoy stunning views from your private deck with Muskoka chairs, a picnic table, and a propane fire pit (propane not included)-perfect for relaxing mornings and cozy evenings.
